title: Otherplaces
description: Multiple dimentions with diffrent items, blocks, mobs, structures, bosses.
body:
This mod adds multiple dimensions that have different items, blocks, structures, mobs and bosses. The dimensions can be accessed with a portal maker and the designated portal core to create a portal. The dimensions have general themes around them and fitting mobs and items to help you on your journey. This mod is currently still in development and will get more dimensions added to it.

The current dimensions are a Sweet dimension that has candy, chocolate and honey everywhere with massive candy canes and a bucket of choccy milk that is awesome.

a Toxic dimension with dangerous air that requires a mask to breathe with dangerous creatures with new ores and potions.

a Cyber dimension with references to popular characters from the internet and a new currency that this city uses for trading with custom shopkeepers and villagers.

and a currently not fully implemented Space dimension that you can get a general idea of from the creative inventory for the time being.

But if these aren’t enough for you dont worry there are more dimensions planned with other new mechanics and challenges.

Keep in mind that some new content might be added to these "old" dimensions and some of these items or mobs might be changed as time goes on.
